content: brick/money 0.13.0 (packagist, still 0.x but stable). Money/Money + Currency objects, exact decimal via brick/math. Supports allocation, rounding modes, currency conversion. PHP 8.1+. For server-side report PDF formatting where Intl NumberFormatter alone may suffice for display, brick/money is only needed if doing money math/allocation. This codebase stores money as decimal:2 columns and computes totals with (float) + round() in SalesOrderService — adding brick/money would be a large refactor; instead use PHP NumberFormatter + intl for display.
